headlines.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Brings Apple Device Automation Into Falcon Foundry Through A New Tie Up
headlines.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings (NasdaqGS:CRWD) and Jamf announced a new integration that links Jamf device management with the Falcon Foundry platform. The partnership brings Jamf workflows for Apple device configuration, compliance checks, and remediation into CrowdStrike security automation pipelines. Enterprises using Mac, iPhone, and iPad fleets can now coordinate security and management actions directly through Falcon Foundry playbooks.

headlines.title: Why CrowdStrike Holdings Stock Flew While the Market Flopped Today
headlines.summary: A fellow cybersecurity company posted a very encouraging quarterly earnings report.

headlines.title: AI Hacking Is “a Fantastic Bonanza” for CrowdStrike and Palo Alto, per Paul Kedrosky
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysPaul Kedrosky called the flood of AI-found software flaws “a fantastic bonanza” for CrowdStrike and Palo Alto Networks. Patching at five to ten times past levels makes security a volume business, with Zscaler and Microsoft in the same wave.

headlines.title: Palo Alto Networks soars on Q1 earnings and Applied Compute deal
headlines.summary: Palo Alto Networks hiked its fiscal 2027 guidance, signaling that customers are spending more to protect AI systems.

headlines.title: Palo Alto Soars 6% on Guidance Hike and $4.5 Billion AI Deal: “An Unprecedented Threat Environment”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysPalo Alto Networks shares jumped 6% after revenue grew 39% and the company raised its full-year outlook. CrowdStrike, Cloudflare, Fortinet and Okta rose with it.

description: CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. provides cybersecurity solutions in the United States and internationally. Its unified platform provides cloud-delivered protection of endpoints, cloud workloads, identity, and data through a software as a service (SaaS) subscription-based model. The company offers corporate endpoint and cloud workload security, managed security, security and vulnerability management, IT operations management, identity protection, threat intelligence, data protection, SaaS security posture management, and AI powered workflow automation, and securing generative AI workload services, as well as security orchestration, automation, and response; and security information and event management, and log management services. It primarily sells subscriptions to its Falcon platform and cloud modules. The company has a strategic alliance with Cognizant Technology Solutions Corporation to help enterprises secure artificial intelligence across its lifecycle, from the AI agents and models to the foundational infrastructure that supports the entire AI ecosystem and with Snowflake to bring AI-native security and enterprise data at scale. Additionally, it has a partnership with Fortanix Inc. to combine its Falcon platform with Fortanix Confidential AI to provide an integrated solution for end-to-end AI security. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.
